SiteBench

SiteBench is a website benchmarking platform that analyzes SEO, AEO, accessibility, performance and UX for teams that need a prioritized action plan.

What is SiteBench?

SiteBench is a website intelligence product that turns a public homepage into structured SEO and AEO findings.

How does SiteBench work?

SiteBench fetches the homepage, extracts observable HTML signals, and scores deterministic checks without claiming AI rankings.

Features

  • SEO analysis
  • AEO analysis
  • Prioritized findings

FAQ

Who is SiteBench for?

SiteBench is for teams that want a structured website audit rather than a generic checker.
